source.label: Large-prime conic profiles and bulk normality

reviewer: Codex with one isolated medium reviewer

claims.summary: For every prime p>=17 and d>=6, D=16d-41,N=8D+8, the actual dimension-eight elliptic source has full conic boundary (r3+r2+s3+rs3)A_D when D!=5, with g=r2s4,r2=1-t,s2=1+bt. A_D=F_(2D+1) except the five explicitly classified residues D=0,1,1/2,-1/2,3/2. At D5 the full exceptional source is (r5+r3s3+r2+s3)F_(2D+1), with independent character coordinates. Source dimensionN is preserved. The generic consecutive marked coefficient is -32(4D+3)^2(4D+5), leaving eight rational residue matrices of size at most17. At p23,D5 the exceptional source takes priority over the coincident ordinary -3/4 residue.
claims.assessment: Working full-source classification passed by one isolated medium reviewer with no gap or unused hypothesis. The exact three-cut pivot determinant has five zeros, whose complete six-column profiles have dyadic unit pivots. The D5 exceptional-domain opposite-point rows have primitive valuations0,1 and scalar primes at most13, giving the consecutive source for every p>=17. Eight integer marked matrices retain actual global powers and actual integer parity. Unit high-outlier elimination introduces no hidden denominator primes; independent finite-Hasse and full-source controls pass.
claims.rationale: Derives a characteristic-uniform full source and finite rational residue inventory, including the exceptional-domain collision. Extends established exact confluence and finite-cut methods; no independent novelty claim.
claims.next_action: Derive actual profiles at the three excluded bulk characteristics7,11,13 without reducing through vanishing rational pivots.

claims.summary: For every prime p>=17, every field of characteristic p, and every d>=6, the original generic dimension-eight root-curve series V_(8,d) has Hasse orders0..128d-321. All rational residue states are covered by exact Frobenius shifts, integer polynomial certificates, and nonzero retained-power factors; characteristic23,D5 is resolved by an exact n0=2 shift of the exceptional source. With previous ternary and quinary proofs, only p7,11,13 remain in dimension-eight bulk. Low degrees in other primes, higher dimensions and pre-stable thresholds are outside this theorem.
claims.assessment: Working uniform theorem passed by one isolated medium reviewer. Six exact integer numerator certificates have nonzero flat coefficients, with their exceptional17,31,1223 coefficients surviving at order2. Two zero flat limits factor by the actual nonzero Frobenius difference y, leaving a cubic unit coefficient. At p23,D5, the exceptional source and n0=2 shift factor into nonzero y, x2+y2, c-1 and a residual polynomial of order5<23. Integer round trips, exact product identities and original-source controls pass; every residue at every p>=17 is covered.
claims.rationale: Proves normality uniformly over all primes at least17 and every bulk degree, rather than accumulating individually tested primes. Exact global-power factors settle zero flat limits. No independent novelty claim for the method.
claims.next_action: Close the remaining bulk characteristics7,11,13 from their actual sources, then the finite low-degree complement; higher-dimensional induction and pre-stable thresholds remain separate.
